  2. Initializes a grid of size N x N with all elements set to -1 (indicating unfilled cells).
  3. Sets the middle element of the grid to "T" to represent Takahashi.
  4. Starts placing dragon parts from a cell adjacent to the center.
  5. Iterates from 1 to N^2-1, placing each dragon part in a cell adjacent to the previous part.

fix_code:
def main():
    N = int(input())
    grid = [[-1 for _ in range(N)] for j in range(N)]
    center = (N - 1) // 2
    grid[center][center] = "T"
    dir = [[0, 1], [1, 0], [0, -1], [-1, 0]]
    dirPath = 0
    x, y = center, center + 1 if N > 1 else center
    grid[x][y] = 1
    for i in range(2, N**2):
        while x + dir[dirPath][0] < 0 or x + dir[dirPath][0] > N - 1 or y + dir[dirPath][1] < 0 or y + dir[dirPath][1] > N - 1 or grid[x + dir[dirPath][0]][y + dir[dirPath][1]] != -1:
            dirPath = (dirPath + 1) % 4
        x = x + dir[dirPath][0]
        y = y + dir[dirPath][1]
        grid[x][y] = i

    for i in range(N):
        print(*grid[i])

main()
